standard_prerequisites.name: Precategories, functors and the functor precategory B^A
standard_prerequisites.statement: A precategory has a type of objects and hom-sets with composition and identities; functors preserve composition and identities, and natural transformations between functors A -> B form the hom-sets of the functor precategory B^A.
standard_prerequisites.use: The statement is about an isomorphism of precategories, i.e. a functor that is fully faithful with an equivalence on objects, and the proof works with identities of functors in B^A (source lines 740-750).

standard_prerequisites.name: idtoiso and isotoid in a precategory
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a precategory A and a, b : A the canonical map (a = b) -> (a iso b) is written idtoiso; in a category it is an equivalence with inverse isotoid, and it takes inverses to inverses and concatenation to composition.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof builds the action of the inverse functor on hom-sets by conjugating with idtoiso of the object-level isomorphism eps_0 (source lines 718-723) and uses its naturality at lines 757-763.

standard_prerequisites.name: Half-adjoint equivalences and the equivalence of the triangle identities
standard_prerequisites.statement: An equivalence of types may be presented by a half adjoint equivalence, whose triangle identity is exactly the object part of equation (9.4.10); the two triangle identities are equivalent, as shown in the chapter on equivalences.
standard_prerequisites.use: Source lines 709-714 identify (9.4.10) with the half-adjoint triangle identity, and line 789 invokes the equivalence of the two triangle identities for the last round trip.

core_obligations: Reduce the labelled triangle equation (9.4.10) to its object part (9.4.11): since hom-sets are sets, equalities between equalities of functors are determined by their object parts, so by function extensionality (9.4.10) is equivalent to map(F_0)(eta_0)_a = opp(eps_0)_{F_0 a} for all a, which is precisely the half-adjoint triangle identity for the object parts (source lines 708-714).

From (i) to (ii): let G_0 be the inverse of F_0 with eta_0, eps_0 satisfying that triangle identity, and define G on hom-sets by inverting the fully faithful F on idtoiso(opp(eps_0)_{b'}) o g o idtoiso((eps_0)_b); functoriality of G follows because idtoiso takes inverses to inverses and concatenation to composition (source lines 716-723).

Produce the two functor identities 1_A = GF and FG = 1_B: transporting the identity action on hom-sets along eta_0 must equal G o F, which is the multline computation using functoriality of F, preservation of idtoiso and (9.4.11) (source lines 725-740); the other identity is the plain inverse property of F on hom-sets (source lines 742-750).

From (ii) to (i): read off that F_0 is an equivalence of types from the object parts of G, eta, eps and (9.4.11), then define the comparison map G-bar on hom-sets by conjugating with idtoiso of eta and show that both composites with F are identities, so that F is fully faithful (source lines 752-777).

Close the three-way equivalence: (i) is a mere proposition so the composite (i)->(ii)->(i) is the identity; the composite (ii)->(i)->(ii) preserves the object parts and recovers the hom-action of G using the other triangle identity (source lines 779-789); finally (ii) and (iii) are both mere propositions, so it suffices to derive (ii) from the mere existence in (iii) by applying the adjointification lemma (source lines 791-795).

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce the labelled triangle equation to its object part and recognise the half-adjoint triangle identity.
Build the inverse functor from (i) and verify the two functor identities.
From (ii) recover full faithfulness of F through the comparison map G-bar.
Compare the two round trips and derive the merely-existential formulation (iii).

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 9.4.9 at source lines 693-703: for a functor F between precategories, being an isomorphism of precategories, admitting G with eta, eps satisfying the labelled triangle equation (9.4.10), and merely admitting such data, are equivalent. The 90-line proof is a three-way equivalence whose real content is (i)<->(ii): the first reduction turns the equation between equalities of functors into the object-level triangle identity (lines 708-714), the action of the inverse functor on hom-sets must then be manufactured by conjugating with idtoiso of the object-level isomorphism and inverting the fully faithful F (lines 718-723), and the two functor identities 1_A = GF and FG = 1_B require a multline computation with functoriality, preservation of idtoiso and the triangle identity (lines 725-750). The reverse direction rebuilds full faithfulness through a second comparison map G-bar (lines 752-777), and the two round trips are not symmetric: the object parts are recovered in one direction while the other needs the equivalence of the two triangle identities (lines 779-795). The statement records none of the transport bookkeeping along eta_0 and eps_0 that the proof depends on.
